description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It models the data related to an employee's termination, including termination date, notes, reason, and associated employee. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying its properties.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's termination record, managed via Doctrine ORM, including properties for termination date, note, reason, and employee reference.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the termination record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the termination record.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Gets the note associated with the termination.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for the termination record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Gets the employee associated with this termination record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this termination record.
